verdict.rationale: Clerk ships an official CLI documented at clerk.com/cli, with commands such as `clerk init`, `clerk impersonate` and `clerk deploy`, local webhook relay, and one-command connection of the Clerk MCP server to AI clients. Its llms.txt tells agents to install the CLI with no global install, API keys or sign-in. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documentation of agent-oriented details like non-interactive or machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: clerk init Start in the repo you already have. Clerk detects the framework, links an app, and adds the auth files your project needs.
Connect the Clerk MCP server to your AI clients in one command, so your agent works with up-to-date Clerk SDK snippets.
Install the Clerk CLI to add auth to your app. No global install, API keys, or sign-in is required.
clerk deploy Ship your auth to production from the CLI.
